comment.text: Plural heading of the metadata section in the files filter; Metadata is the section name and {{count}} is the number of conditions set. Keep the middle dot.

usage.context: {!state?.conditions.length ? t("Common:SubmenuMetadata") : state.conditions.length === 1 ? t("Metadata:ConditionsCount_one", { count: 1 }) : t("Metadata:ConditionsCount_other", { count: state.conditions.length, })}
